newsitem.title: USA: Dallas-Fort Worth airport chief gets big contract.
newsitem.headline: Dallas-Fort Worth airport chief gets big contract.

text.p: The Dallas-Fort Worth Airport Board has awarded Executive Director Jeff Fegan a 5-year contract guaranteeing him an annual salary of $200,000 plus benefits, officials said Wednesday.

Spokesman Joe Dealy said the package will make Fegan one of the highest paid airport executives in the country and that he is the only Dallas-Fort Worth airport employee to have a multi-year contract.
"The airport board feels that Jeff simply has done an exceptional job and that the contract is an appropriate award," Dealy said.

Fegan, who became executive director in 1995, reports to the 11-member airport board. He can only be removed from his post during the life of the new contract if judged to be guilty of gross neglect of duty or for a criminal conviction.

Fegan has drawn up a $1.7 billion airport expansion plan for the next five years, to be financed with joint revenue bonds from the airport and the cities of Dallas and Fort Worth along with a $3 per ticket passenger surcharge and a contribution from American Airlines, which is headquartered here.
